title: EcoMandala: Hexagonal NFTs for Geospatial Data Integrity on Cardano

ms.promise:
(A) Research report detailing the target use cases for EcoMandala's hexagonal NFTs
(B) Design document for the EcoMandala framework and a detailed plan for this PoC project.
ms.criteria:
(A) Research report details at least three potential use cases for the minting of hexagonal NFTs
(B) Design document should outline the data structure and blockchain interaction as well as provide a preliminary design of the user interface and API

ms.promise: (A) Concept implementation implementation of an automated process which produces the Ecomandala hexagonal images and mints corresponding NFTs using an API
ms.criteria:
(A) The concept implementation covers one of the use cases described in the first milestone's report 
(A) a sample of 1,000 NFTs are minted to cover a territory of interest for the selected use case
ms.report:
An automated system (backend, database, API and UI Portal) for generation of EcoMandala NFTs for large area projects have been implemented and extensively tested using a collection of high-impact nature restoration projects as a target use-case. A large collection of 1000+ EcoMandala NFTs have been minted and listed in the linked spreadsheet.
Milestone 3 detailed report: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1c3cuohnTZ9qzTPh7pGKga7wuZbIyDM0P/view
EcoMandala Portal: https://gamayos.github.io/pcf12-ecomandala/ecomandala-20241229-1.html
NFT list (1000+ mints in three projects): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-PgtYcHZqVcBQc0DjswwFcXsXMlnL4imdXXXPHpmHgo/edit?usp=sharing
